featured_reviews.name: Elton Lobo
featured_reviews.review_text: Pauline Book & Media Centre in Borivali is a peaceful and welcoming place run by the Pauline Sisters. Though small in size, it has a vast and meaningful collection of Christian books, devotional items, and thoughtful gifts for all ages. The sisters are very kind, polite, and always ready to help you find what you need. More than just a bookstore, it feels like a place of reflection and spiritual nourishment. Highly recommended for anyone seeking quality spiritual resources in Borivali.

featured_reviews.name: yash morajkar
featured_reviews.review_text: This is a lovely outlet managed by the Pauline Sisters. You can get yourself some beautiful story books and novels. I'd urge all the parents to definitely take your little ones here, they'll thank you for the memorable reads. Keep the good work going sisters! Amen.
